name: com.aizekhan.rpg-framework
description:
Reusable building blocks for RPGs: composition root and DI, event bus, systems and ECS, combat, stats, progression, quests, inventory, items, loot, dialogue, crafting, save/load, asset management, pooling, prefab spawning and UI navigation. Game content and rules stay in the game project.

Requires UniTask (com.cysharp.unitask). Addressables support turns on automatically when com.unity.addressables is installed.
